lead_raw_text:
The structure of K3In crystallizes in the cubic space group Pm-3m (No. 221), with a unit cell containing four atoms and two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both In and K centers adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors per center atom: In is surrounded by 12 K neighbors, while K has 4 In and 8 K neighbors, all at 3.7145 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all four sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner, edge, and face sharing among K-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and edge and face sharing between In- and K-centered polyhedra.
